During the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] ([[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]-[[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]), an '''''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer''' was deployed to [[Spaceport THX1138]] after it was discovered that a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel agent]] was attempting to board a ''StarSpeeder 1000'', with several Imperials being deployed to arrest the agent. It ended up severely damaged by smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] while the latter was aiding the flight in escaping during a run-in of his own with the Imperials.
